findings.summary: The threshold annotation 'half the base peak (0.67)' is placed inside the plot area and drawn across the left panel's grey base bar: the text runs x 109-349 while the bar occupies x 197-263, so the words 'base' and most of 'peak' sit on the bar fill. Where they cross the bar they are #5c5c5c on #929292, about 2.1:1, so the bound the section asked for is the least readable label in the figure and the bar it is measured against is partly covered by text.

The third right-panel group, 'plan documents doubled', carries only the this-change bar (1.80) and an empty base slot, while the other two groups show a grey/blue pair and the legend names both revisions. A reader cannot tell whether the base revision was measured there and failed to plot or was never measured; the caption does not say. The number is real - the evidence text records this arm as a within-change 1.51 to 1.80 comparison - so the fix is a caption sentence, not a bar.

The caption calls the threshold 'the dashed line in the left panel', but the line as rendered is a fine dotted rule; a reader looking for dashes is directed at a mark that is not there. Otherwise the caption adds information rather than repeating the alt text.

The two panels use different tick-label precision for the same quantity (0.0/0.2/1.4 on the left, 0.00/0.25/1.75 on the right) and different y limits, so the same bar height means a different value in each panel. Both axes are labelled in GiB and every bar carries its value, so this does not mislead a careful reader, but the inconsistent formatting is visible and cheap to make uniform.

rubric_items.contrast: fail: where the threshold annotation crosses the base bar its glyphs are #5c5c5c on the #929292 bar, about 2.1:1 against a 4.5:1 requirement; text on white clears comfortably.
rubric_items.data_ink: pass: solid bar fills and a single labelled threshold line carry all the ink; no gradient, texture or decorative fill.
rubric_items.decoration: pass: no gradient, background fill, grid or styled theme; top/right spines are absent.
rubric_items.label_collision: fail: 'half the base peak (0.67)' (x 109-349) overlaps the base bar (x 197-263) in the same rows; nothing is clipped at the canvas edge (ink spans x 26-1386, y 24-697 in a 1400x720 canvas).
rubric_items.legibility: fail: the bars, titles, tick labels and value labels read at a glance, but the threshold annotation 'half the base peak (0.67)' is drawn across the base bar, so two of its words are hard to read where they cross the bar.
rubric_items.table_form: pass: seven values with a bound drawn across the left panel, so the picture carries the comparison; a table would not show the bound against the base peak.
